[Set / Update API Key](command:deepseek-copilot.setApiKey) · [Clear API Key](command:deepseek-copilot.clearApiKey)
deepseek-copilot.config.maxTokens.descri: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default. Useful for controlling costs.
Enable the official DeepSeek **Web Search** tool (`#deepseekSearch`). When disabled, the tool is hidden from the Copilot Chat tool list and cannot be called. Each successful search request is billed.
deepseek-copilot.config.webTools.fetch.e: Enable the official DeepSeek **Web Fetch** tool (`#deepseekFetch`). When disabled, the tool is hidden from the Copilot Chat tool list and cannot be called. Each successful fetch request is billed.
deepseek-copilot.config.experimental.sta:
**Experimental**: improve DeepSeek context-cache hit rate by pre-activating available tools.
- When the enabled tools list changes across turns, this may improve DeepSeek context-cache hit rate.
- Requests will include more function definitions, so input tokens may increase. Cache-hit input tokens are billed at a lower price, but still count toward usage.
- This may add internal preflight tool calls to the current Copilot chat history. If you switch to another model in the same conversation, that model provider may reject or mishandle the replayed history. Start a new chat if model switching behaves unexpectedly.

Use [Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools) to **view and manage** your tool list:

- 64 or fewer enabled tools: usually no need to enable this unless the tool list still changes across turns.
- More than 64 enabled tools: consider this setting only if the tools list changes between turns and DeepSeek context-cache hits are poor. Larger tool lists may increase input tokens.
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.descri:
Controls what diagnostic information DeepSeek Copilot writes. Token usage is always reported to Copilot regardless of this setting.

- **Minimal** — Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or request dumps.
- **Metadata** — Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata (request hashes, prefix overlap, tool schema changes). Does not contain prompt text — safe to share in public issue reports. View with [`DeepSeek: Show Logs`](command:deepseek-copilot.showLogs).
- **Verbose** — Complete request payloads written to disk for local debugging. **Warning: contains sensitive prompt content.** View with [`DeepSeek: Open Request Dumps Folder`](command:deepseek-copilot.openRequestDumpsFolder).
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.minima: Token usage only. No diagnostic logs or dumps.
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.metada: Privacy-safe metadata. Safe to share publicly. View with `DeepSeek: Show Logs`.
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.verbos: ⚠️ Contains sensitive prompt content. For local debugging only.
deepseek-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides: Override the API model ID sent for each DeepSeek model. Defaults are prefilled with official DeepSeek IDs; change them only when using a compatible third-party API that uses different model names.
API model ID for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Pro
deepseek-copilot.tool.webSearch.userDesc: Search the web with the official DeepSeek Search API. Each successful request is billed.
deepseek-copilot.tool.webSearch.modelDes: Searches the web with the official DeepSeek Search API. Returns ranked results with title, URL, publish date, site name, authority score, rerank score, summary, and snippet; when need_content is true, full page content is also included. Use it when the task needs up-to-date or external information that is not in your training data or the workspace: news, recent releases, current documentation, or facts you are unsure about. Do not use it for questions answerable from the workspace, open files, or stable well-known knowledge, and do not use it to fetch a page the user already gave you (use the fetch tool instead). Each successful request is billed, so keep count small (5-10) unless the user asks for more.
deepseek-copilot.tool.webFetch.userDescr: Fetch a web page as Markdown with the official DeepSeek Fetch API. Each successful request is billed.
deepseek-copilot.tool.webFetch.modelDesc: Fetches a single web page with the official DeepSeek Fetch API and returns its title and full content converted to Markdown. Use it when the user asks to read or open a specific URL, or when you need the full text of a page found via search and the summary or snippet is not enough. Only http/https URLs with a host are supported; URLs must not contain userinfo. Do not use it to search the web (use the search tool instead) or for pages whose content you already have. Each successful request is billed.
